Confirm if more such games enter and the older ones keep their Most Popular positions beyond week 8; refute if they fade like other +1 templates (H-te-004).

new.statement: A rolling release calendar of small content drops (Clean The Ballpit shipped eight themed maps in 17 days and appears on all four charts: Most Popular riser +15, Top Earning #287, Top Trending #11, Up-and-Coming #9) keeps a young game on several charts at once
